scientific_boundary: Family gene tree is not a species tree.
Zero means not detected by the current member evidence, not validated loss.
External species are excluded from pan-family occupancy denominators.
Pairwise Ka/Ks does not prove positive selection.
Group association is not adaptation or domestication causality.
Inference uses cluster-level independent units, not all raw pairs.
Species-level units are used; genes are not biological replicates.
Uncontrolled population composition cannot support causal claims.
Logo shows aligned amino-acid conservation, not validated structure or function.
HOG and gene denominators are distinct and must not be merged.
HOG quality and occupancy remain visible beside gene count.
Gene and HOG counts are separate measures.
Fractions are interpreted with their absolute denominators.
Higher pairwise Ka/Ks is not proof of positive selection.
Chromosomes from different species are not placed on one physical coordinate axis.
Conflicts and unassigned genes remain in the denominator audit.
Family duplication pairs cannot substitute for whole-genome synteny blocks.
Cross-species patterns depend on outgroup, assembly and annotation quality.
Descriptive association does not show that a mode caused a subfamily.
This is a gene-level denominator and does not establish causal direction.
Only audited whole-genome anchors and blocks are drawn as syntenic links.
Similarity alone is not synteny evidence.
Hit composition does not quantify regulatory contribution.
Unmapped motifs remain explicit instead of being discarded.
Scaled color is paired with raw and rate source values.
Small cells and motif hits are not inferential enrichment results.
Assembly, annotation and detectability can affect species patterns.
Top-N is a display filter, not an importance ranking.
Expression units and sample applicability must be explicit.
Cross-species absolute TPM is not directly compared.
Tissue mapping, species normalization and independent units are required.
A heatmap cannot replace a group-by-subfamily statistical model.
Heatmap color is descriptive and not differential-expression evidence.
Formal DE uses raw integer counts, registered contrasts and BH-FDR; TPM is excluded.
